info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Access Management API
info.description: The Customer Access Management API facilitates the modification of access entitlements for customers within the banking ecosystem. This endpoint allows authorized users to update the access privileges associated with specific customer accounts, ensuring that entitlements are aligned with the latest business requirements. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions managing customer access, compliance teams monitoring entitlement changes, and system integrators facilitating access updates. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance security and streamline customer management processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the access entitlements for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. It is essential for maintaining accurate access controls and permissions associated with customer accounts.

requestBody.description: Update the access entitlement for a customer. This request allows modification of the customer's access settings and permissions associated with their account.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the customer's access entitlement has been updated.
